query.description: Natural language query. Describe what you're looking for conversationally. The system embeds this and finds semantically similar knowledge items.

project_id.description: Filter to a specific project. Three-way semantics: omit to use session context project (if set); pass a project ID to filter to that project; pass null to search globally, ignoring session context.

kinds.description: Filter to specific knowledge kinds. Use sparingly; semantic search naturally ranks relevant kinds higher. Most useful for explicit structural queries like 'show me all decision records for this project'.

tags.description: Filter by tags (AND semantics: items must have ALL specified tags). Tags are lowercase. For OR semantics, make separate queries.

time_range.description: Filter by creation time. Either or both bounds may be specified.

include_superseded.description: Include items that have been superseded by newer understanding. Default false.

include_standing.description: Compute and return standing (evidential profile) for each result. Adds minor latency. Recommended when assessing reliability.

include_references.description: Return references (file paths, URLs, concepts) attached to each item.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response's next_cursor.
